text:
- [LGRA.5.9.5] Legal on `logical` schemas only. `tolerance` on a
  `ttl`-scoped schema is a **compile error** (`DS_VALIDATE_TOLERANCE_TTL_SCHEMA`):
  `ttl` / event facts carry no identity and do not dedup ([LFAC.1.7.6]), so
  there is no within-tolerance reassertion to suppress. On a schema of any other
  non-`logical` lifecycle it is `DS_VALIDATE_TOLERANCE_NON_LOGICAL`. See [LFAC.2.5.1]
  and [LFAC.2.6.4].
